notes: B2C orders and their proforma invoice fixed: a B2C order now has Bags / packs and Rate / bag (₹) for each item (the rate is filled from Buyer B2C and can be changed). The proforma invoice uses exactly those bags and the rate per bag (amount = bags × rate per bag) instead of reading the master rate; the B2C sales invoice made from the order gets them too. The item must have its Kg / bag in Buyer B2C. In emails, {Item qty} of a B2C invoice / proforma is in bags.
